content.text: Replace this text and the input_json data with actual validated evidence for this question batch.

questions.name: S01
questions.instructions: How complete and internally consistent is the listing title, attributes, images and variants? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Cannot identify product.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Numerous missing/misleading critical fields.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Basic fields but essential variant or usage details missing.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Main attributes, images and variants consistent.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Comprehensive, specific, accurate listing with clear variant selection.

questions.name: S02
questions.instructions: How persuasive and reliable are reviews considering rating, count and substantive complaint themes? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Strong credible negative pattern or unresolved severe defect.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Many credible repeated negative complaints.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Mixed reviews or limited sample.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Predominantly positive, sufficiently numerous relevant reviews.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Consistently strong substantive reviews with issues addressed; representative volume.

questions.name: S03
questions.instructions: How competitive is SKU price against like-for-like comparable listings, after normalized unit/size? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Highly overpriced without defensible value.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Meaningfully overpriced relative to verified comparable SKUs.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Near-market pricing with unclear differentiation.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Competitive price for equivalent variant/size.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Compelling value relative to verified close substitutes with comparable terms.

questions.name: S04
questions.instructions: How well can currently observed stock cover expected near-term demand? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Unavailable or confirmed impossible fulfillment.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Chronic stockouts / severe variant gaps.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Some variants unavailable or uncertain stock.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Most key variants available and stable replenishment.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Key variants reliably available with adequate replenishment plan.

questions.name: S05
questions.instructions: How well does the SKU address verified market demand (not just video views)? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Evidence of little demand in target market.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Weak demand relative to alternatives.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Moderate/noisy demand evidence.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Clear recurring demand across credible signals.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Strong sustained and relevant demand supported by multiple sources.

questions.name: C05
questions.instructions: How clearly does the video differentiate the SKU from realistic alternatives? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No differentiation.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Vague superiority claim.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: One distinguishing characteristic but no context.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Relevant differentiator supported by demonstrated feature.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Meaningful differentiator supported by relevant product comparison/evidence.

questions.name: C09
questions.instructions: How consistent are product claims, variant and visuals with the matched SKU listing? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Material contradiction or clearly different SKU.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Multiple important mismatches.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Partial match with unresolved variant/claim differences.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Strong match; minor ambiguous details only.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Exact product/variant and major claims match listing evidence.
